summary: RawData Joint_Moments.csv is N*m/kg, not N*m as README line 32 says; Joint_Powers.csv is W/kg, not W (line 33). Seed 20261030 drew AB02 incline_walk_2, AB01 incline_walk_2, AB03 weighted_walk_1, AB10 incline_walk_1, AB08 weighted_walk_1 (8 legs; AB03/AB08 right plate absent). A mass-free lever-arm ankle moment in N*m from Virtual_Insoles (calcn frame; norm equals GroundFrame_GRFs to 6e-12 N; CoP moves forward in 253/254 stances) regresses onto the source ankle column with slope 1/64 to 1/90 (implied normalizing mass 64.2-90.0 kg; 46-113 kg over a 3 x 3 ankle-position grid; correlation 0.9975-0.9998). A N*m column would give slope 1. Peak raw ankle values -1.1 to -2.3 against lever-arm peaks -94 to -192 N*m. Force-plate body mass (2 x mean single-leg vertical force over strides / g, minus the 11.3 kg vest for weighted walking) matches the README mass in 5/5 subjects: AB01 80.0 (78.9), AB02 85.1 (82.2), AB03 113.8 (113.5), AB08 87.5 (87.6), AB10 64.6 (67.5). Power = source moment x Joint_Velocities in rad/s, ratio 0.963-1.005, so powers carry the same per-kg normalization. Ankle sign is dorsiflexion-positive internal (positive slope), consistent with the survey.

verdict.units: N*m/kg (moments) and W/kg (powers) in RawData CSV_Data; README "Nm" and "W" are wrong

verdict.converters: Copying raw values as Nm_kg (current converters) is correct for units; body-weight GRF normalization still needs the publisher mass table.

remaining: Follow-up (not resolved): AB03 normalizing mass. The verifier found implied normalizing masses of 78-85 kg for AB03 (fixed and free lever, 2 tasks, 4 legs), while AB03's own models (Scaled1/4/9) and the force plates give about 113.5 kg. An AB02 model of 82.18 kg sits in AB03's folder, and the local mass table lists 82.18 kg for AB03. If the authors normalized AB03 by 82.18 kg, AB03 moments and powers are about 38 % too large. Needs a model-specific check and possibly a José exclusion/correction decision.

Follow-up (not resolved): per-trial scale anomalies. AB05 incline_walk_2 implies 114-120 kg against a README mass of 71.5 kg (plates 69-70 kg), implied/README up to 1.68, wider than the 0.73-1.33 this probe reports. AB10 incline_walk_1 (1.33) and AB08 weighted_walk_1 (0.73) are milder. Cause unknown (wrong model per trial, task-specific processing, or lever-arm limits); per-trial check needed before any release.

Which mass the authors divided by is not resolved (implied/README 0.73-1.33 with a generic ankle position). AB03 matters: README 113.5 kg vs local model table 82.18 kg; if the authors used a wrong model mass, AB03 moments are off by about 38 %. Next bounded check: parse each subject model's subtalar location (AB03 model provenance first) to sharpen the implied mass.
Hip and knee columns were not lever-armed; they share the file and show per-kg magnitudes (p1/p99 within about +/-1.5).
decision_note: No convention choice remains; units are a measured fact. The AB03 denominator may later need a José exclusion decision if the model check shows the wrong mass was used.
